|quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Penance Brand''' is a [[spell]] that creates a [[brand]] at the target location, which when attached to an enemy adds Energy stacks which cause the enemy to explode at 20 Energy. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''Activation frequency''': Brands proc their effects at intervals determined by activation frequency, which is every 0.1 seconds by default. This frequency is affected by increases and reductions to [[cast]] speed; however, it is not affected by more/less multipliers (e.g. {{il|Spell Echo}}) or modifiers to [[action speed]]. These stats do affect the actual cast time of the brand, however (which determines how quickly the brand can be placed). * '''Duration''': Once attached, Penance Brand does not have an attached duration so it will not expire and will remain on the enemy until the brand explodes, the enemy dies, or the brand is otherwise detached. ** {{il|Swiftbrand Support}}'s attached duration penalty is effectively ignored, removing its downside. * '''Energy''': Penance Brand adds a stack of Energy to the enemy it is attached to each time the brand activates, up to a cap of 20 Energy. Energy is simply a counter on the enemy and not a [[debuff]]. When the enemy reaches 20 Energy, the earliest attached Penance Brand will be destroyed and cause an explosion on the target. Immediately after this explosion occurs, Energy is reset to 0, and any other attached Penance Brands will begin to add Energy again. Detaching the brand (e.g. killing the enemy before the brand explodes, using {{il|Brand Recall}}, or proccing the [[Brand Mastery]] {{c|mod|Brands Attach to a new Enemy each time they Activate, no more than once every 0.3 seconds}}) will also reset the Energy to 0 without causing an explosion{{cite web|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3452002#20|title=Path of Exile 2 and Path of Exile: Affliction Recently Asked Questions|date=December 4, 2023|accessdate=December 4, 2023}}. ** While it is theoretically possible to use the Brand Mastery with Penance Brand, it is not very synergistic, as you would need to add 20 Energy within 0.3 seconds, or an activation time of <0.015 seconds (or <0.03 seconds with two brands), and the exploded brand would be unable to transfer to a new enemy. * '''Multiple brands''': If multiple Penance Brands are attached to an enemy simultaneously (via [[Runebinder]]), each brand will independently add Energy stacks towards the shared 20 Energy cap, accelerating the rate at which the cap is reached. However, only one brand will explode on reaching 20 Energy. * '''Interaction with {{il|Penance Brand of Dissipation}}''': If Penance Brand is attached to an enemy with a Penance Brand of Dissipation already attached, and Energy is currently below 20, the regular Penance Brand will explode on reaching 20 Energy and reset Energy to 0, resetting PBoD's damage and radius scaling. However, if PB is attached while an enemy is already at 20 Energy from PBoD, it will never "reach 20 Energy", so PB will remain attached and not explode until PBoD expires, resetting Energy to zero, then reaches 20 again from PB alone.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Anb9HA5Jv7E Ultimately, these gems are anti-synergistic with each other. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression | c1_abbr = Physical

Quality now provides Deals +0-15% more Damage with Hits against Branded Enemy (previously +0-10%). }} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * Now has 470% Effectiveness of Added Damage at gem level 1, scaling up to 570% at gem level 20 (previously 570% at all gem levels). }} {{Version history table row|3.24.0| * Fixed a bug where Penance Brand (and its transfigured versions) could fail to remove energy from a target when detaching. }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Penance Brand has been significantly simplified. * It no longer spreads energy to nearby enemies or causes regular pulses while at maximum energy. * It now immediately causes an explosion when the branded enemy reaches maximum energy. * It no longer causes an explosion when it expires or detaches from an enemy. * It no longer has an attached duration - instead, it remains attached to the enemy until it reaches maximum energy, then expires immediately once the explosion occurs. * It no longer gains damage or radius per energy. * It now deals 177-265 base Physical Damage at gem level 1 (previously 18-27), scaling up to 2541-3811 gem level 20 (previously 170-254), has an added damage effectiveness of 570% (previously 40%), activates every 0.1s while attached (previously every 0.5s) and has a base radius of 2.8 metres (previously 0.8 metres). * It now deals 30% less Damage with Ailments. * Quality now causes the skill to deal +0-10% more Damage with Hits against Branded Enemies, instead of providing 0-10% increased Area of Effect. }} {{Version history table row|3.17.0| * Penance Brand explosions now deal 90% more Damage with Ailments per Energy after the first (previously 60%). }} {{Version history table row|3.16.0| * Now has “Explosions deal 60% more Damage with Ailments per Energy after the first” (previously 100%). * Because of base Ignite damage changes, Ignite with the skill is now 54.8% higher. }} {{Version history table row|3.11.0| * Penance Brand has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Skills}}
